game_title: Truth Table Tiles – Island Ferry Defense
game_concept: A survival strategy set in Coastal Port – Island Ferry, the island ferry landing: the sailor must handle kraken tentacles while practicing conditionals (if / elif / else). Core idea – Truth Table Tiles: Fill in truth-table tiles for and/or/not to light the correct path.
theme: Coastal Port – Island Ferry: the island ferry landing
core_gameplay_loop: In Island Ferry, repeat each round: Fill in truth-table tiles for and/or/not to light the correct path. Each round, kraken tentacles strike the ferry, so respond before the next strike lands. Then check the table_score value and advance.
player_objective: Protect the ferry from kraken tentacles in Island Ferry: keep the table_score meter above zero by applying the concept correctly until the 24-second timer ends.
controls: Keyboard: arrow keys move the hero, SPACE performs the main action, ENTER runs the code.
lose_condition: table_score drops to 0, or lives reach 0, before the 24-second timer ends.
learning_alignment: Week 3 – Conditionals (if / elif / else) | Level 1 (intro tier): Truth Table Tiles
assets_style: pixel-art harbor town: deep blue sea, wooden docks, orange-roofed buildings, sailing ships; flat Kenney-style sprites; sea-shanty accordion with wave and gull ambience
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Truth Table Tiles' (Week 3 slot 14), mission type 'Survival Siege', and setting 'Island Ferry'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Coastal Port
region.mood: sea-shanty accordion with wave and gull ambience

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how table_score changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against kraken tentacles in Island Ferry.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: Timer reaches 24 seconds while table_score > 0.
